title: Expose additive source-aware XML and DTD entry points
api_or_output: Add two source-aware overloads with every parameter required; previous signatures preserved

acceptance.description: Freeze/implement exact additive all-required signatures XmlDocument.Load(Stream input, XmlParseOptions? options, Uri sourceUri, CancellationToken cancellationToken) and DtdSchema.Compile(string dtd, XmlResourceResolver? resolver, XmlResourceLimits? limits, Uri sourceUri, CancellationToken cancellationToken). Preserve every previous public row and null/default-literal overload call. Uri nonnull/absolute validation before transport/resolver work; no ambient grant.

Delegate source identity through existing byte DOM adapter and DTD subset initial XmlLocation, retaining parse/DTD models, final redirected resource bases, quotas/cancellation/stream ownership/cleanup/exception identity. Focused public tests prove relative external subset/entity/PE resolution, final URI diagnostics, invalid source no IO, old defaults and source compatibility. No scanning/callback algorithm changes.

Demonstrate both entry points using verified dependencies; fresh actual10.0.11 focused/earlier source and compiled API checks plus task validation/owned diff; integrated evidence before CLI consumes. Constructor/source propagation has no new steady-state algorithm; cumulative allocation regressions remain M6 gate.

implementation: src/Xemele/Parsing/Dom/Factories.cs: required source-aware Load and shared private LoadCore
src/Xemele/Validation/Dtd/DtdSchema.cs: required source-aware Compile and shared private CompileCore
